The '''1938 National Division''' was the second edition of the [[Turkish National Division]]. [[Güneş S.K.|Güneş SK]] won their first title.

==Overview==
[[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] got into a conflict with the [[Turkish Football Federation]], as they initially wanted to play the home games in their own homeground, but the federation declined the request. Fenerbahçe claimed that their travel expenses were not paid appropriately by the TFF and withdrew after the 4th match.

==Participants==

*[[Güneş S.K.|Güneş SK]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 1st
*[[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 2nd
*[[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 3rd
*[[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 4th
*[[Harp Okulu S.K.|Harp Okulu]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 1st
*[[Muhafızgücü]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 2nd
*Üçok - [[İzmir Football League]], 1st
*[[Altay S.K.|Alsancak]] - [[İzmir Football League]]
